court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Civil Judge, Senior Division, Barshi (Hindu Marriage Petition No.134 of 2021)
case_name: Sureikha Hanumant Kale Wife Of Rohit ... vs Rohit Dilip Raut on 25 April, 2022
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Matrimonial discord led to criminal complaint and DV Act proceedings; husband initiated divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act; mediation failed.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish hardship.
legal_principles.held: Applicant has pressed an issue of hardship and also the ground of likelihood of recording of overlapping findings as it is claimed that D.V. Act proceedings and divorce proceedings are based on similar set of facts and evidence.

legal_principles.principle: The court may consider the likelihood of recording overlapping findings in divorce proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Applicant has pressed an issue of hardship and also the ground of likelihood of recording of overlapping findings as it is claimed that D.V. Act proceedings and divorce proceedings are based on similar set of facts and evidence.

outcome.final_order: Hindu Marriage Petition No.134 of 2021 is transferred from Civil Judge, Senior Division, Barshi to Civil Judge, Senior Division, Kalyan.
